messages:
Alex: Heads-up 10: Vendor alerted us: APAC allocation down ~15% due to customs hold + a small DOA batch. We need ~28 H200s for regional capacity.
Priya: Which depots have available stock? Any fast crossship options?
VendorRep: Affected S/N blocks: 41xxx-41200. AMS pool has 5, EWR has 8. We can prioritize 6 expedited replacements for next Tue if amendment signed.
Sam: Crossship (air expedite) cost ~ $1.4k/unit incl. brokerage; diversion per AWB ~ $1k. Spot purchase premium ~ +$3.5k/unit.
OpsBot: AWB 992-441-7001 created; current ETA EWR hub 2026-04-03 11:00 UTC. Diversion allowed with surcharge.
Priya: Ops note: provisioning map for loaners ~2.5 hrs per 10 units. Ops capacity low this sprint.
Alex: Vendor offered 30-day loaners at $45/day and $800 AWB credit on one diversion if we accept amendment on insurance value.
FinanceOps: Ad-hoc spend >$30k needs exec OK.
Sam: Proposal: divert 8 from EWR (pay surcharge), accept 14 loaners, and take 6 expedited replacements. That covers 28.
Priya: Agree, but we need vendor to sign insured value amendment in writing. Also require manifest-level DOA photos before RMA credits.
VendorRep: Amendment draft sent. We'll accept photo manifests and will apply $800 credit after confirmation.
Alex: Action items: Priya -> confirm insurance amendment; Sam -> lock forwarder and surcharge; Ops -> prep DOA photo manifest if needed. I'll prepare exec summary for FinanceOps.
FinanceOps: Please tag exec for sign-off; queueing procurement hold until approved.
Priya: :thumbsup: drafting amendment signature now.
Sam: Forwarder locked; estimated final surcharge per AWB = $995.
Alex: Thanks team 10: will file PO change once exec sign-off arrives.
